institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York

remedy.notes: The June 22, 2023 Opinion and Order on Sanctions imposed a $5,000 sanction jointly and severally on Peter LoDuca, Steven Schwartz, and Levidow, Levidow & Oberman P.C., and ordered notices to affected judges and the client. The indexed filing_date is the sanctions opinion and order filing date; the action entered federal court on removal on February 22, 2022.
